papers.title: Tocilizumab in patients admitted to hospital with COVID-19 (RECOVERY): a randomised, controlled, open-label, platform trial
papers.abstract: In this randomised, controlled, open-label, platform trial, several possible treatments were compared with usual care in patients admitted to hospital with COVID-19. In patients with hypoxia and evidence of systemic inflammation, tocilizumab improved survival and other clinical outcomes.

papers.title: Tocilizumab in patients admitted to hospital with COVID-19 (RECOVERY): a randomised, controlled, open-label, platform trial.
papers.abstract: Tocilizumab improved survival and other clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients with hypoxia and systemic inflammation.

papers.title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19
papers.abstract: In patients hospitalized with Covid-19, the use of dexamethasone resulted in lower 28-day mortality among those who were receiving either invasive mechanical ventilation or oxygen alone at randomization but not among those receiving no respiratory support.

papers.title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19 - Preliminary Report
papers.abstract: Preliminary report of the RECOVERY randomised evaluation of dexamethasone in hospitalised patients with Covid-19.
papers.venue: The New England journal of medicine

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms.
papers.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: Remdesivir for the Treatment of Covid-19 - Final Report
papers.abstract: Remdesivir was superior to placebo in shortening the time to recovery in adults who were hospitalized with Covid-19 and had evidence of lower respiratory tract infection.
papers.venue: The New England journal of medicine

papers.title: Colchicine in patients admitted to hospital with COVID-19 (RECOVERY): a randomised, controlled, open-label, platform trial
papers.abstract: In adults hospitalised with COVID-19, colchicine was not associated with reductions in 28-day mortality, duration of hospital stay, or risk of progressing to invasive mechanical ventilation or death.
